{{Top|leg}}
A '''data book''' was a small [[Memory chip/Legends|memory chip]] that could be inserted into [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] or other similar devices that contained literature. They could be read on a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] screen, or read aloud by devices with compatible speech synthesizers, such as [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]].<ref name="GOA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref>
